parsed_json.up_exec: Return distinct IC50 activity records (in nM) for the human single-protein target Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1 (CHEMBL221). For each record, include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID, fall back to DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and the document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
